_doc: Semantics lane (steer 7, Q17b; revised after review 4, R4-08/R4-09) proposed matrix cells. Orchestrator integrates. Run ids are registered under evidence/runs/; the first pass's ids are superseded by the -r2 ids.

cells.evidence_grade: inspected (axioms stated with sources at the pin; every finding classed by hand) + mc (module-00 composition, model-level)
cells.product_basis: 208 of 309 counted findings (duplicates not counted) break at least one of the 14 axioms (axioms.json violating_findings); each of the 14 axioms is broken by at least one finding; S1 findings breaking an axiom: 44
cells.remaining: the repaired SYS-I wording (AX-01..AX-09) is proposed in semantics/src/axioms_src.json, not written into ontology/00-system.md (ontology lane); AX-12's durability half rests on an intent-undecided premise (F-C1102)

cells.evidence_grade: mc (explorer, exhaustive within declared bounds, none truncated; 243 mechanism checks: one generic machine per mechanism over a trait, one instance per object variant; 48 negative controls, at least one per law, all caught; every Keep check with its complement (all safety laws explored alone)); not proved
cells.product_basis: 59 of 77 objects hand-roll at least one mechanism; for every modelled instance the laws its as-built model violates equal its declared departures, each with a finding or a named exception (EXC-05, EXC-06, EXC-11), checked by sem-check-r4
cells.remaining: the playbook's 'generic lemmas proved once over a trait' (Verus) are not written: PROOF-DEBT D-14 (a separate proof lane); 75 axiom-breaking findings are not attached to a mechanism instance (MECHANISMS.md, last section); no result transfers to the product

cells.evidence_grade: inspected + check (8 canonical lifecycles, one meaning per id; 77 of 77 objects derived from the ontology's Entity lines: 75 declare a lifecycle with every state and command mapped, 2 carry an explicit reason; every object declares mechanisms and axioms; checker with seeded mutations)
cells.product_basis: the canonical mapping shows states the mechanisms forbid or lack at the pin: IVF and BM25 indexes have no stale state (F-0606, F-0703), the queue entry has no running/claimed state (F-C0601, F-C0670), the reifier has an orphan state (F-1502)
cells.remaining: none for the gate text; the ontology's own entity names collide across modules (namespace in 01/17/18, result cache entry in 04/10, caller transaction in 03/11): resolved in the mapping, not renamed in the ontology (ontology lane)

cells.evidence_grade: check (mechanical: every B/T/I/X/P ontology statement of 19 modules, 2939, exactly once; contract clauses of round r6 and contract-2) + inspected (rule precision by a sample of 80 of the first 2,600: 68 agree, 10 partly, 2 disagree; one reviewer, not independent)
cells.product_basis: a trace is a property of the specification; the product's conformance is in the other cells
cells.remaining: 55 requirements open after the re-trace against the contract-2 clauses (none of them is decided by E-1, S-1 or an X2 clause; 17 already-traced statements gained one): 42 of the 53 open P premises are held by a named contract-2 outside premise (assumed, not validated; outside_premise in trace.json: P2-ABSENT 7, P2-SEC 5, P2-CATALOG 4, P2-DICT 4, P2-LIMITS 4, P2-SQLEXPR 2, P2-SQLTEXT 2, and 14 families once each); 11 P premises have no clause and no premise family (third-party library facts ALG-P1, ALG-P4, ALG-P5, INT-S1.12; driver and packaging OPS-P4, OPS-P6; language OPS-P12; not engine behaviour OPS-P16, INS-P4.16; engine behaviour no family covers WRT-P5.12, TMP-P4); 2 I cost/memory rules (TXT-B4.8, INT-R1.13); 1183 B/T statements trace only to their module's functional contract (DC-FUNC-NN), whose L1 models are not checked statement by statement; the precision sample predates the 339 ontology-2 statements

cells.evidence_grade: mc (explorer, exhaustive within bounds: two tenants, four processes; 29 checks)
cells.product_basis: the universal axioms model-checked over the composed mechanisms M-01, M-02, M-03, M-04, M-05, M-10: the reviewed composition keeps AX-02..AX-08, AX-10..AX-12 and AX-14 (complement empty); the as-built composition violates AX-06 (F-1101, F-1306), AX-07 and AX-11 (F-1302), AX-08 (F-0702, F-0606), AX-10 (F-1306, F-0702), each check attributed to one axiom and the complement showing all of them in one model; one control per axiom (11) caught, 6 of which also break other axioms; 4 sharpness witnesses
cells.remaining: AX-01, AX-09 and AX-13 are outside the composition (checked by the generic machines M-12/M-01, M-08, M-11: sem-mc-catalog-*, sem-mc-install-*, sem-mc-cap-*); AX-02, AX-03, AX-04, AX-05, AX-12 hold within the composition only, the product breaks them elsewhere (axioms.json); progress rests on TRUST.md's operator-re-run premise

cells.evidence_grade: mc (explorer, exhaustive within bounds; F-C0605 by bounded overtaking and a fair-lasso liveness check over the full reachable graph)
cells.product_basis: F-C0605 now has a model: as built, an entry is overtaken more than N-1 times (M07-L3) and a fair cycle keeps it pending forever (M07-L4); AG EF holds as built (why breadth-a's bounded model could not show it); reviewed FIFO passes both, a LIFO control is caught by both; also F-0604, F-C0601 and the new F-C0670 (two workers on one entry) in the generic queue machine
cells.remaining: fair_lasso is tooling added in models/semantics (unproved; its controls are the FIFO pass and the LIFO and as-built catches); the batch size is abstracted to 1
